tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi gnad bsdus sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ na mo mahā mu drā ya/ kun la khyab cing gdal ba chos kyi sku// rang rig gdod ma'i sems dang dbyer med par// ston mdzad 'gro ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// ngag dbang bzang pos deng 'dir bde legs mdzod// dad brtson shes rab nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// bag yod dran pa'i rta ljang gis drangs tshe// kun rmongs mun pa'i dpung tshogs ga shed bros// bcos ma'i dmigs gtad lcags kyus rig pa'i rtsal// yang yang 'gugs pa'i ngal bas ci zhig btub// rang babs gnyug ma'i rang 'gros 'di kho nas// 'ching grol med pa'i lam bzang dbye bar bya// thub pa chen po'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas// mtha' drug tshul bzhis dngos brgyud 'chad tshul rnams// phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i thabs su gcig /'dir ni gcer mthong mngon sum nyid du'o// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhis// 'chad pa sgrub brgyud 'di yi bka' srol te// ma bslad mi gnas mi 'gal mi dmigs pa// gzhi la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi'o// ye dag ye rdzogs sems kyi rang bzhin 'dir// dri ma bsal dang dri med bzhag rgyu zhig /med phyir gang gis ma bslad bcings grol med// gnyis brjod mtha' bral bsam brjod yul mi gnas// gang yang min kyang gang dang mi 'gal bar// ji snyed chos kyi rjes su 'jug ldog mkhan// ji bzhin brjod pa rgyal ba'ang tshig gis dbul// dpe bral mi dmigs chos 'di ngo mtshar che// gshis la sangs rgyas sems can rnam dbye med// 'khor bar 'khyam med myang 'das thob mkhan med// su yang ma bcings su yang grol ba med// dge bas ma phan sdig pas gnod pa med// de ltar lags kyang rmongs pa glo bur bas// 'khrul mkhan med pa'i 'khrul pa 'di ltar bzos// rang gi rang bcings srin bu'i kha chu bzhin// rang gis rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin// rang gis rang stor rgan po'i tha gu bzhin// med la yod 'khrul yod la med 'khrul nas/

'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni drag tu 'khor// skyid sdug nyin mtshan gnyis po res kyis spyod// smig rgyu chu bos ri dwags skom drir bsad// bye ma'i khang bus byis pa a thang bcad// rang gi mgo bo rang gis lan brgyar bskor// da gdod de der ma 'dzin rang sor zhog /de phyir 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa zhes// dmigs su med kyang kun rdzob rdzun nang du// rmi lam skyes bus rmi lam chu brgal bzhin// nyams su len pa'i lag len 'di la 'bad// las dang skal ba mthun pa'i bla ma las// snying por dril ba'i man ngag gnad thob nas// 'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri khrod bas mthar ru// mi rtog skye med gnyis med bsam mi khyab// rnal 'byor bzhi po 'di la rim bzhin bslab// 'gyu ba dgag bya gnas pa bsgrub bya zhes// mi rtog rang babs ngang nas dran shes kyi// mel tshe rgyang sor 'dzugs la man ngag yin// gang las skyes dang gar gnas gang du 'gag /dpyad pas ma rnyed pa na dpyod pa po'ang*// shing gnyis drud las skyes pa'i me bzhin du// skye ba'i rang bzhin med pa nyid du rtogs// sna tshogs snang yang gcig pu du ma'i nyams// rang sems 'gag pa med pa'i rang rtsal te// rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i klong yangs su// gnyis med sgyu ma chen po'i gar byos shig /bsgom bya sgom byed la sogs gnyis chos kyi// bar lag de ni rang bzhin shes pas sgyel// bsam gyis mi khyab gnyug ma'i rgya mtsho cher// 'khor 'das chos kun skyur dang sgom chen pa// de de'i myong ba 'char tshul 'di yin te// bzung dran stobs su gyur pas gnas thog der// 'gyu ba phra rags rig 'phral gnas par khugs// gnas 'gyu bar 'gyel rtse gcig rnal 'byor zer// 'gag med rtog par 'gyu ba gnas lugs sgo// rang ngo shes pa'i gnad kyis rang sar grol// gzhi rtsa bral ba'i gnad kyis rang rig pa// 'khrul grol bar 'gyel spros bral rnal 'byor zer// chu rlabs chu bzhin yul snang gnas lugs kyi// rang 'od nyid phyir bden par ci ste grub// yul thog rang zhal lta ba'i gnad shes na// snang sems bar 'gyel ro gcig rnal 'byor zer// 'dag bya'i dri ma zad pas 'dag byed kyi// gnyen po'i rtsol ba'ang de bzhin nyid du zad// lam gyi 'jug pa chad nas gzhi thog sleb// mnyam rjes bar lag med de sgom med lo// de de'i rnal 'byor bzhi po re rer yang*// brtan pa ma thob pa dang cung zad thob// shin tu thob pa'i rim pas chung 'bring che'i// rnam gzhag bcu gnyis dag gis spu ris 'byed// de dag yon tan nyid kyi rjes 'gro'i phyir// re re nang gses dbye bas bzhi bzhi ru// lung rigs myong ba rtogs pas phye ba zhig

mkhas dbang grub pa'i dad dpon che rnams bzhed// ngo mthong rnam rtog sgom shar rtsal rdzogs dang*// yon tan skyes dang kun rdzob rang byan tshud// gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs dang de de min/ rnam pa bcu gnyis dbye ba'ang gong ma'i srol// sngon 'gro tshogs lam rtse gcig sbyor ba'i lam// spros bral mthong lam ro gcig sgom pa'i lam// sgom med mi slob lam du 'chad mod kyi// 'di la'ang mtha' dpyad 'phrul gyi sgo glegs dbye// chos kyi dbyings las g.yo med rtse gcig ste// bag chags dang bcas sgrib pa'i spros pa bral// smon lam dbang gis gzhan 'dul ro gcig yin// thog mtha' bral ba'i don gyis sgom du med// de ltar gzhi dang nyams len nyams myong dang*// drod rtags 'byed dang 'bras bu mngon gyur pa'i// rnal 'byor bzhi tshan lnga pos phyag rgya che'i// gnad phal bshad nas slar yang 'di skad smreng*// dam pa'i drin las brnyed pa'i gnad ldan na// gol shor 'phrang la rdugs pa'i go skabs ci// blun sgom log pa'i lam las bsrung slad du// ngos 'dzin skyon gyi tsher ma 'di ltar 'byin// shor sa bzhi ste gshis dang lam gnyen po// rgyas 'debs shor ba re rer ye shor dang*// 'phral du shor ba gnyis gnyis 'byung de yang*// go yul 'chel dang nyams myong 'khrul pa'o// stong dang rten 'byung don gcig rnam kun gyi// mchog ldan yin par ma go lung rigs kyis// dpyad pa'i med dgag tsam dang sngags don la// 'khrul pa'i stong rkyang blo bzo gshis shor yin// gzhi 'bras dbyer med na'ang lam gsal byed// 'bras bu bral 'bras yin tshul ma rtogs pas// stong nyid lam du byas las chos sku zhig /sgug sdod byed pa'i blo de lam shor yin// spang gnyen rnam dbyer med pa ma go bar// sbyin sogs dmigs bcas bsgom mthar gang dang gang*// stong nyid yin snyam ri bo gser bsgom gyis// de der rgya yis 'debs rnams ye shor ba'i// stong nyid snying rjer longs pas dang po sel// shar grol dus mnyam rtogs pas gnyis pa 'gog

/spang gnyen dbyer med go bas gsum pa dbyung*// yin lugs ji bzhin shes pas bzhi pa 'byin// gnas lugs yang dag ma yin rnam spyi tsam// don du bzung bas gzhan la smra shes kyang*// rig thog nges ma 'drongs pas khang stong la// sgo lcags btab pas gshis la 'phral shor yin// sems ngo cung zad shes kyang gnas 'gyu gnyis// rang sar 'dzin med ma grol som nyi za// tha mal shes pas ma tshim bcos lhad kyis// lhan pa 'debs pa lam du 'phral shor yin// gnas lugs sgo chen gdangs las 'gyu ba'i rlung*// yul thog 'phyo ba rang sar ngo shes kyi// yang dag dran par mi ldang lcags kyu bzhin// 'bad pas 'gugs pa gnyen por 'phral shor yin// sgom la bdag po med pas dran shes bzhin// srol du ma tshud dred por 'phral shor dang*// rjes su ma thob rnam rtog bre yi kha// sgom gyis 'gengs pa blo chung 'phral shor gnyis// bla ma'i drin gyis ma nor ngo 'phrod nas// rang mtshan 'khrul pa med pa'i dran pa dang*// shes bzhin bag yod 'khar ba la brten nas// shor sa med kyi thar lam drang por srongs// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog la zhen pas// 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi// khams su gol mod rang bzhin yongs shes pa'i// gnad la dril bas sgom gyi yang rtser khugs// snang dang rnam rtog stong pa dgrar langs gegs// rim bzhin sems dang chos sku snang stong gnyis// zung 'jug nyid du shes par rang sar grol// de dag shor gol gegs sel man ngag gnad// mdor na shar tshad rang sems gcig pu'i gar// yin phyir brtags na gegs dang dngos grub ces// tha dad su yis 'dzin pa de blun po// de phyin mnyam nyid ngang du chos kun rdzogs// le lor gnyid pa'i sgom chen rgan po la// sgom phrug thub bstan nyin byed kyis bskul ba'i// ngo ma chog par gong ma'i gsung bsnyen nas// cha lag yongs su rdzogs par bri la spro// mang du thos pa'i dpal 'dzin ku sā li// ngag dbang mgrin mtshor rol pa sangs rgyas kyi// rdo rjer bod des dag pa'i snang ba kun// rab tu 'byams pa'i khang brtsegs mchog tu bkod// dge legs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag brgya// gcig tu tshogs lta'i 'od dkar phung po yis// sgrub brgyud kun+da'i 'dab rgya yongs grol nas// snyigs dus mtshan kyang nyin bzhin dkar gyur cig
/bkra shis gang zhig ma rig byed pa'i blo// ye shes dpung pas gnon pa'i mthu grub pas// rigs brgya'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpal thams cad// skal bzang gtsug tor mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog/ //
